_comment: Default corpus catalog shipped with Veritate. Each entry's stem is the on-disk basename (foo -> foo_train.bin / foo_val.bin in trainers/corpus/). format='raw_bytes' = direct URL written as a uint8 byte stream (Veritate trains byte-level, so plaintext bytes ARE tokens). format='hf_dataset' = stream rows from a HuggingFace dataset, encode each text column as UTF-8, separate rows with two newlines. format='native' = the bins ship inside the repo at veritate_mri/data/corpus/; install copies them into trainers/corpus/ with no network, and sizes are read from the bundled files. format='zip_bundle' = train_url is one hosted zip holding <stem>_train.bin + <stem>_val.bin; install extracts both and deletes the zip; sha256 fields verify the extracted bins. coming_soon=true disables install until the corpus is published: replace the PLACEHOLDER train_url with the real COS link and drop the flag to release. max_bytes_train caps how much of streaming HF data is written before stopping. val_split_ratio carves off the tail of the downloaded train file as val.bin when no separate val source is supplied. recommended_min_params / _max_params drive the training-tab size-mismatch warning. Size ladders were retired 2026-08-20: one entry per corpus, no small/medium/large tiers, and recommended_min_params/recommended_max_params are null on every entry. Match corpus to model by content, not by byte count. The dashboard prompts the user for confirmation before installing any corpus larger than 10 GB; the backend additionally requires confirm_large=true in the install body for those. Dashboard grouping: family = 'carpathian' (Carpathian-published families: chat/agent/mcp/code/sft) or 'public' (external published datasets: fineweb_edu, wikitext103, etc.). topic groups within a family (chat, agent, mcp, code, knowledge, market, special_sft). Both are advisory; if omitted the dashboard falls back to per-stem defaults.

corpora.label: Model Context Protocol docs
corpora.description: The full modelcontextprotocol.io documentation, ~2 MB. Ships inside Veritate (no download). Layer on top of a chat model.

corpora.label: Tiny Shakespeare
corpora.description: All Shakespeare's works, ~1 MB. Classic warmup for tiny models.

corpora.label: FineWeb-Edu (sample-10BT)
corpora.description: Educational web text (HuggingFaceFW), 10B-token sample, ~5 GB. Best for 50M-500M models (Chinchilla-optimal).

corpora.label: WikiText-103
corpora.description: Wikipedia article subset (Salesforce, raw), ~500 MB. Best for 30M-200M models.

corpora.label: enwik8
corpora.description: First 100 MB of English Wikipedia (Hutter Prize). Classic byte-level benchmark. Best for 5M-50M models.

corpora.label: PG-19 (Project Gutenberg pre-1919)
corpora.description: Public-domain English books published before 1919 (DeepMind PG-19, Apache-2.0; texts are US public domain). Streamed from the emozilla/pg19 parquet mirror because the original deepmind/pg19 repo is a script dataset that datasets>=4 refuses to load. Capped at 10 GB. Clean book prose; best writing-register source for 50M+ models.

corpora.label: FineWeb-Edu (sample-100BT slice, filtered)
corpora.description: 8 GB educational web prose streamed 2026-08-21 from HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu sample-100BT (ODC-By 1.0, commercially usable). Every row passed corpus_filters (clean -> quality -> pii -> near-dedup) plus a code/markup-marker reject (``` , def/import lines, HTML tags, js): 1,803,827 docs kept, 79,687 rejected (74% boilerplate/dedup, 3.2% code markers). Distinct sample from the sample-10BT fineweb_edu bin; use one or the other in a mix, not both. UPLOAD PENDING: local-only, needs a COS link.

corpora.label: Project Gutenberg PD books (beyond PG-19)
corpora.description: 6,905 English public-domain Project Gutenberg books NOT in PG-19, built 2026-08-21 from sedthh/gutenberg_english (MIT packaging, PG headers stripped). PD gate: kept only books whose every catalogued author (gutenberg.org pg_catalog.csv) has a death year <= 1928, so all content predates 1930 and is US public domain; 30,826 unverifiable books rejected, 9,674 PG-19 duplicates excluded by PG ebook id. Cleaning: CRLF normalized, residual PG markers stripped, double-spaced hard-wrap artifact reflowed into paragraphs, garbled/low-alpha books dropped (879). UPLOAD PENDING: local-only, needs a COS link.

corpora.label: OpenWebText (10 GB subset)
corpora.description: GPT-2-style web crawl (Skylion007), capped at 10 GB. Best for 100M-500M models.

corpora.label: SlimPajama (6B-token public subset)
corpora.description: Cleaned, deduplicated RedPajama sample (DKYoon mirror), ~22 GB. Best for 100M-500M models (Chinchilla-fit).

corpora.label: Crypto byte corpus (1m OHLCV, 200 pairs)
corpora.description: 1-minute OHLCV for 200 Binance USDT pairs as a byte stream. For the Market LLM (numbers, not language).

corpora.label: Python code (clean, 1 GB)
corpora.description: Filtered (edu score 3+) Python from Stack-Edu, syntax-validated and near-deduplicated. Best for 200M-3B models.

corpora.label: JavaScript code (clean, 1 GB)
corpora.description: Filtered (edu score 3+) JavaScript from Stack-Edu, minified files rejected, near-deduplicated. Best for 200M-3B models.

corpora.label: HTML (curated, 50 MB)
corpora.description: HTML from permissive-license repos (MDN, web-platform-tests, templates), filtered and near-deduplicated. Mix-in for code models.

corpora.label: CSS (curated, 3 MB)
corpora.description: Handwritten-scale CSS from permissive-license repos; compiled framework builds removed. Small by design: mix-in for code models.

corpora.label: Coding Q&A (StackOverflow, 100 MB)
corpora.description: StackOverflow Q&A on py/js/html/css (answer score 5+), ChatML framed. Teaches intent-to-code mapping.

corpora.label: Mixed code ablation: raw (200 MB)
corpora.description: Ablation control: py/js/html/css at 40/40/10/10, exact dedup only, no quality filter. Best for 80M-800M models.

corpora.label: Mixed code ablation: filtered (200 MB)
corpora.description: Ablation arm: same 40/40/10/10 mix, full structural filters, near-dedup, edu score 3+. Best for 80M-800M models.

corpora.label: Mixed code ablation: textbook tier (200 MB)
corpora.description: Ablation arm: same mix, full filters, edu score 4+ only (phi-style textbook tier). Best for 80M-800M models.

corpora.label: Mixed code ablation: Q&A interleaved (200 MB)
corpora.description: Ablation arm: filtered code 50% + StackOverflow Q&A 50% (ChatML framed). Best for 80M-800M models.

corpora.label: Code textbook (synthetic, distilled)
corpora.description: Textbook-style teaching corpus: concept explanations, runnable examples, worked exercises, and buggy-vs-fixed pairs across py/js/html/css. Every document syntax-validated (py/js executed with passing asserts). Small and dense: distillation-grade data for ablations and SFT layering.

corpora.label: SFT: IDK + chit-chat + jokes + in-domain QA
corpora.description: SFT layer that teaches abstention ("I don't know"), greetings, jokes, and in-domain QA. Layer on top of a chat model. Best for 80M-1B models.

corpora.label: Veritate Conversation v1
corpora.description: Self-authored conversational corpus for Veritate research: multi-turn dialogue, long-range carry-over, grounded reading with honest refusal, correction/repair, entity-tracking comprehension, format-constraint following, prose/writing style, sense-of-self, news, and jokes.

corpora.label: Veritate v1 conversation layer
corpora.description: Self-authored US-register conversation, carryover, comprehension, format-constraint, writing, cogito, jokes and news. Research use.

corpora.label: Veritate conversation layer
corpora.description: Self-authored US-register conversation, carryover, comprehension, format-constraint, writing, cogito, jokes and news. Research use.

corpora.label: Veritate SFT dialogue
corpora.description: Dialogue-only SFT set: conversation, carryover, comprehension, format-constraint, cogito. Prose genres excluded on purpose.

corpora.label: Identity and sense of self
corpora.description: Authored cogito records: fixed Veritate self-model, honest limits, epistemics.

corpora.label: Instruction execution
corpora.description: Authored instruction-execution SFT corpus: exact counts, exact lengths, avoid-a-letter, JSON shape, transform, extract, compute, classify.

corpora.label: US Congressional Hearings
corpora.description: Transcripts of United States congressional hearings (CHRG collection, govinfo.gov). U.S. Government work: public domain. Formal-register turn-depth source for chat SFT mixes; cap transcript corpora at 0.20 of a mix (measured 2026-08-16).

corpora.label: UK Hansard Debates
corpora.description: Transcripts of United Kingdom parliamentary debates (Hansard). Parliamentary information licensed under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0. Formal-register turn-depth source for chat SFT mixes; cap transcript corpora at 0.20 of a mix (measured 2026-08-16).

corpora.label: US Supreme Court Opinions
corpora.description: Opinions of the Supreme Court of the United States. Edicts of government: public domain. Formal legal-register source for chat SFT mixes.

corpora.label: Agent tools
corpora.description: Tool-calling conversations (calculator, fs_read, fetch, retrieve). REBUILD PENDING: the three retired size tiers held 275,897 unique user turns inside 1.5 GB (1.9% unique content, measured 2026-08-20). Rebuild deduped via tools/build_agent_corpus.py with a per-conversation hash gate, then publish one tier.

corpora.label: Mixed chat
corpora.description: Multi-turn ChatML conversations. Measured 2026-08-20: 218 MB, 371,214 turns, 98.8% unique user turns, 88% unique content bytes, median assistant turn 265 B, artifact rate <1 per 1k turns. The reference quality bar for any newly built chat corpus. UPLOAD PENDING: local-only, needs a COS link.

corpora.label: E4 memory benchmark (50 facts)
corpora.description: IDEA 20 E4 sleep-consolidation benchmark corpus: 50 novel person->attribute facts (25 residences, 25 occupations) x 20 templated augmentations each, both directions, rendered as assistant-masked chat turns. Deterministic rebuild: python -m tools.build_fact_sft veritate_mri/data/eval/e4_facts.json --per-fact 20 --seed 0. Validated recipe: fact_sft:0.75,mixed_chat:0.25 at constant lr 5e-6 (successes.md 2026-08-21, wren1_5@700 fwd 45/50 rev 49/50). Experiment artifact, not general training data: models trained on it will score high on tools/e4_retention_quiz.py by design.
